Bundle of the 18 dances (Op. 4 Nos. 13-30) that the print issues inside Op. 4; only selections recorded (Clematis 4, Savino about 8), no complete recording found, minutes unknown. Wikipedia: Nos. 1, 3, 4, 7, 8 are concerted, the violone has solo passages, and the notes say so, yet instruments fold the violone into continuo (players 3). note: Systemic: the bass rule is applied unevenly. Legrenzi entries count the violone/viola da brazzo beside the continuo (2 vn + cello + continuo = 4 players); Leonarda's, with the same print layout (2 violins, violone, organ), fold it (3 players). Legrenzi's printed title pages ('doi violini e violone, con il basso continuo') and A-R's Leonarda edition list violone and continuo separately, but whether the violone has a line of its own was not checked in scores; the owner should settle one rule for these baroque trio sonatas. Op. 10 vs Op. 11 for La cetra: kept Op. 10 (printed number), IMSLP's Op. 11 is in aka. Floor evidence is thin for 100929 (one Dynamic track) and 100945 (own-label album).
